title: Step
description: What story_step returns: the next action the host should take for a member. The server picks the action each call; the host repeats the call.

order_id.description: The order the action is about. Null for done with nothing to wait for.

claim.description: The order is unclaimed: the server claims it for the member before the host acts.

render.description: The direction is stored but not rendered yet: the server renders first.

open_order_ids.description: Every order the member holds in a working state, in production order. A batch host reads this to know what it has running.

$comment: The server emits every field. A reader may treat a missing field as its default. A step is parsed as strictly as every other ledger record: an unknown key is refused and no scalar is coerced (the string 'true' or the integer 1 is not a boolean). The action repin is addressed to the server, never to the host.
